title: Young Woman in Formal Dress by Vintage Car, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A clear post-WWII black and white snapshot taken on July 5, 1948, featuring a smiling young woman posing in a long white formal gown next to a late 1930s or early 1940s automobile. Her hair is styled with decorative hair ornaments popular in the late 1940s. In the background, a sign reads 'WEEKS LUMBER & COAL CO.' along a rural or industrial roadside, encapsulating small-town Americana during the post-war era.
